outcome: A standalone shot used as [B-roll / visual bridge / material detail / test shot]
subject: The visible subject and material
action: One visible cause, physical response, and payoff
camera_intent: locked and deliberate; movement only if it serves the event

layers.music: none unless the edit needs it
